steps.text: Stage 1: Build ACME Order Hub normally with Spring Framework 5.3.18. Representative Spring CVEs show as open.
Stage 2 prep: In Nexus, host a fake Lightwell package (5.3.18.rhlw-00010) and include it in maven-public. Optionally publish the app JAR to acme-releases.
steps.visual:
Nexus hosted: lightwell-java-remediated-mock
upload-mock-to-nexus.sh
publish-app-to-nexus.sh → acme-releases

steps.text: Rebuild with the lightwell profile. Dependencies resolve through Nexus; only the Spring version suffix changes.
Jackson and Commons Text pins stay the same. Application code is unchanged — Nexus is where Lightwell enters the supply chain.
steps.visual:
jackson-databind = 2.13.4.2
commons-text = 1.9
Lightwell path = Nexus hosted mock
